earnings.title: Zoom Communications Reports Financial Results for the Third Quarter of Fiscal Year 2027
highlights: Third quarter total revenue of $1,290.6 million, up 4.9% year over year as reported and in constant currency
Third quarter Enterprise revenue of $805.4 million, up 8.6% year over year
Third quarter GAAP operating margin of 24.6% and non-GAAP operating margin of 41.6%
Number of customers contributing more than $100,000 in trailing 12 months revenue up 8.5% year over year
Repurchased approximately 3.9 million shares of common stock in the third quarter, bringing the total shares repurchased under the current plan to 48.1 million

quotes.text: Zoom delivered another strong quarter, with Enterprise revenue growth accelerating to its strongest pace in 13 quarters. Zoom Customer Experience was a key driver, posting its seventh consecutive quarter of high double-digit year-over-year ARR growth.

outlook: Fourth Quarter Fiscal Year 2027: Total revenue is expected to be between $1.293 billion and $1.298 billion and revenue in constant currency is expected to be between $1.293 billion and $1.298 billion.
Non-GAAP income from operations is expected to be between $539.0 million and $544.0 million.
Non-GAAP diluted EPS is expected to be between $1.55 and $1.57 with approximately 298 million weighted average shares outstanding.
Full Fiscal Year 2027: Total revenue is expected to be between $5.100 billion and $5.105 billion and revenue in constant currency is expected to be between $5.086 billion and $5.091 billion.
